product.description: Agitația cuprinde întregul sătuc St Mary Mead atunci când celebra actriță Marina Gregg cumpără o casă aici. Vine să facă un film, are de gând să se stabilească în sat și chiar va organiza o serbare! Toată lumea se grăbește să participe la petrecere. Mai puțin Miss Marple, care nu este astfel de față când o admiratoare a actriței moare după ce bea un cocktail otrăvit. Dar cine ar fi avut motiv să ucidă o femeie cam băgăreață, e drept, dar absolut inofensivă? Sau poate doza fatală de otravă era destinată chiar frumoasei Marina Gregg? Cu ajutorul relatărilor contradictorii ale martorilor și al intuiției sale fără greș, Miss Marple descoperă că uneori o întâmplare banală din trecut poate avea consecințe dezastruoase...

# Oglinda sparta by Litera: A Classic Mystery Affair with Miss Marple

Dive into a charming yet dangerous tale of community drama when Marina Gregg arrives in St Mary Mead. The release of **Oglinda sparta** (The Mirror) from Litera plunges readers back into the beloved world of Agatha Christieâs literary detective, Miss Marple. This gripping mystery novel promises suspense, local gossip, and a seemingly perfect village facade hiding dark secrets.

## A Village in Crisis

When celebrated actress Marina Gregg moves into St Mary Mead, her arrival sends ripples of excitementâand tensionâthroughout the entire community. She plans to film a movie and even hosts a grand celebration, drawing all the residents together for one unforgettable evening. Everyone is eager to participate in the festivities, but not Miss Marple.

## The Mystery Unfolds: Suspense and Intrigue

The idyllic gathering takes a sudden, dark turn when a local admirer of the actress dies after consuming what she thought was a simple cocktail. Who had the motive? It's certainly not obvious. While the victim might have been considered flirtatious, she is undoubtedly harmless.

Miss Marple must navigate a web of contradictory witness accounts and rely on her unparalleled intuition. The central question remains: Was the fatal dose of poison intended for poor Marina Gregg herself? *Oglinda sparta* masterfully demonstrates how even the most mundane event from one's past can lead to catastrophic, life-altering consequences in the present day.

If you enjoy classic cozy mysteries and brilliant amateur sleuthing, this book is a must-read addition to your collection of mystery novels by Litera.

**What kind of book is *Oglinda sparta*?**
It is a classic mystery novel featuring Miss Marple, focusing on a poisoning incident in the English village of St Mary Mead.

**Is this part of an ongoing series?**
The story continues Miss Marple's adventures and fits within the genre of popular detective fiction published by Litera.

**What should I expect from the plot?**
Readers can expect local drama, suspicion among neighbors, and Miss Marple using her keen observational skills to uncover a truth buried beneath superficial village charm.
